title: a market is a set of towns, and the zip decides which one a person is in

criteria.text: A market is a row of whole counties and split-county subdivisions; every other county is its own waiting market; moving one is one row; may cross states
criteria.note: `markets`, `market_members`, `market_key()` (#693, PR #708); Sacramento = four counties, Tahoe-basin CCDs carved out as a waiting market; any other county answers `county-<fips>` with no rows [V]. Checked: no: `tests/markets-db.test.ts` is marked partial only; two-state market not tested. Reviewed: no (review-skipped).

criteria.text: A zip resolves to exactly one market the same way every time (zip to county to market; subdivision inside a split county); unknown zip refused with the exact words
criteria.note: `zip_county` (33,486 zips), `zip_market_key`, refusal "We don't recognize that zip, try again." (#694, PR #709) [V]. Checked: no: `zip-market-db.test`, `zip-market.test`, `landing/actions.test`, `onboarding/actions.test` all marked partial. Reviewed: no (review-skipped).

criteria.text: The zip-to-county source is the HUD-USPS crosswalk, largest residential share wins
criteria.note: Stand-in: Census 2020 ZCTA files, largest land area, 10,174 zips flagged `guess`; PO-box-only zips unknown (#694 PR body, #693 comment) [V]. HUD token not registered.

criteria.text: The zip decides, nobody picks: open market signs in, waiting market joins that waitlist and is named; no IP, GPS, default, shortlist or picker
criteria.note: Sign-up and /landing resolve the market and name it; no list or select (#694) [V `OnboardingFlow.test.tsx`]. Explore still falls back to Sacramento for a visitor (#588, F104/F105 scope, not sign-up). Checked: no: markers are partial; no scan for IP or GPS. Reviewed: no (review-skipped).

criteria.text: Nothing member-facing reads the MSA or CSA; no surface shows MSA, CSA or metro
criteria.note: Sign-up screens are clean (`OnboardingFlow.test.tsx`, partial); `msa_code` is a column on `markets` [V]. Missing: /you "Default metro" row, Explore metro switcher, `msa_code` reads in `explore/actions.ts`, `location-actions.ts`, `/api/boundaries` [V]; no standing guard. Needs a PM call (#848).

criteria.text: A member in an open market has a home town (Place their zip mostly lies in, else county remainder), re-resolved when the zip changes, private
criteria.note: `members.home_town`, `zip_home()`, `member.zip.set`, Zip row on /you (#695, PR #757) [V]. One-tenth land-share threshold is a stand-in for population weighting (PR body). Checked: no: `home-town-db.test`, `home-town-private.test`, `zip-set.test` marked partial. Reviewed: no (review-skipped).

criteria.text: A member in a waiting market gets a home town the day it opens
criteria.note: `backfill_home_towns(market)` exists and is tested (`home-town-db.test`) [V], but nothing calls it: no code opens a market (#616 comment names the call). Half built, so no.
